retractions.title: Retraction-resurfacing check
retractions.ok: Retraction-resurfacing check: OK (%(count)d retractions, %(documents)d documents scanned)
retractions.missing_key: `retractions.json` has no `retractions` key — a broken structure is not the same as 'no problems'
retractions.no_docs: not a single living-state document was scanned — an empty input is not a pass (zero-value guard)
retractions.resurfaced: %(name)s:%(line)d carries a retracted assertion "%(text)s" (%(entry)s): either delete it or add the correction marker
